description:
Classify each prose paragraph and each commit message paragraph as German or English with stop words, plus umlauts and ß as a second signal. Code, paths, and inline code do not count. A paragraph with a weak signal takes the document language and gets marked as weak for T-006. Add the `prose_languages` policy key, default `["en", "de"]`, and `adw-config prose-languages en,de`. Code comments stay English. The length threshold stays open until T-010 measures it on the T-003 corpora (decision Q18). Notes N-001 to N-007 hold every decision.

Acceptance.
1. A German paragraph and an English paragraph in one file get their own language.
2. `prose-languages en` sends every paragraph through the English rules.
3. A measurement script reports detection accuracy per paragraph length on the T-003 corpora.
title: Detect paragraph language with stop words
